tasks.description: Indexes the requests of a plain-text API collection by folder, method, path and auth. Use when asked for a request index of an API collection.
tasks.intent: Index the requests of a plain-text API collection.

tasks.description: Checks which variables the API requests use against the collection's environment files. Use when asked for a variable usage report of an API collection.
tasks.intent: Report variable usage and gaps across the collection's environments.

tasks.description: Summarizes how thoroughly each request in an API collection asserts on its response. Use when asked for an assertion coverage summary of an API collection.
tasks.intent: Summarize assertion coverage of the API requests.
